lessonTitle: 49. Decomposing a vector along non-coplanar vectors

stages.headline: If a, b, c are non-coplanar, every vector p in space is uniquely written as p = xa + yb + zc.

stages.headline: In a cube with a = AB, b = AD, c = AA₁: AC₁ = a + b + c and AB₁ = a + c.

stages.headline: Example: if O is the centre of the cube, AO = ½(a + b + c).
